column2: [intro]
I love playing squash in my small hall
With my racket, I’m having a ball
The bounces, the volleys, drive me wild
But in this game, I’m always mild
I hit the ball against the wall
I strike it, it’s a sure call
But when I miss, what despair
Squash sometimes makes me quite unfair
I run from left to right, I’m so agile
Opponents find me very futile
But I don’t care, I’m here for fun
In my neon shorts, I’m the one
I hit the ball against the wall
I strike it, it’s a sure call
But when I miss, what despair
Squash sometimes makes me quite unfair
[ solo ]
So if life makes you a bit morose
Come play squash, it clears neuroses
We have fun, we laugh, always in excess
Squash is the remedy for all stress
[outro]
